snippet.title: Erased | Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Go wishlist Erased on steam now!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3121890/Erased/

Follow me on my journey to independently develop "Erased", an action-packed psychological whirlwind! I'll be posting daily updates where you’ll get to see me not only develop this video game but “become” my video game character. You'll get to see behind the scene stunts, character creation, animations and more.
